title: CTRL: Concurrent Training and Rollout for LLM Reinforcement Learning via GPU Co-Residency
abstract: arXiv:2611.27119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models runs two GPU workloads with different hardware demands: rollout decoding, which is dominated by memory access and whose batch shrinks as responses finish, and a dense learner. Current systems either time-share every GPU between them, paying serial phases and switches, or split GPUs into pools whose sizes change only in whole devices. We present CTRL, which makes co-residency a third RL execution layout: every GPU runs a learner rank beside a persistent rollout engine, sharing the device under CUDA MPS. A host-owned learner makes the layout fit: optimizer state stays in host memory, and policy weights stream layer by layer through a bounded GPU window. A publication gate trains each ready batch first and waits only before releasing the next policy, keeping a dropless staleness bound. A step-time bound guides compute-share selection, and a GPU-time ledger explains overlap

translated_title: CTRL：通过GPU共存实现LLM强化学习的并发训练与Rollout
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的强化学习（RL）后训练需要运行两种硬件需求不同的GPU工作负载：rollout解码，它以内存访问为主导，且其批次大小会随着响应完成而不断缩小；以及稠密的学习器（learner）。现有系统要么让每张GPU在两者之间进行时分复用，付出串行阶段和切换的开销；要么将GPU划分成资源池，但其规模只能以整卡为单位变化。我们提出CTRL，将共存作为第三种RL执行布局：每张GPU在常驻的rollout引擎旁边运行一个learner rank，并在CUDA MPS下共享设备。主机侧拥有的learner使这一布局得以落地：优化器状态保存在主机内存中，策略权重通过一个有界的GPU窗口逐层流式传输。发布门控（publication gate）先训练每个就绪的批次，仅在发布下一版策略之前等待，从而保持无丢弃的陈旧性上界。步时上界（step-time bound）指导计算份额的选择，GPU时间账本（GPU-time ledger）则解释了重叠情况。
tldr: CTRL提出将GPU共存作为LLM强化学习的第三种执行布局，让每张GPU同时常驻运行learner与rollout引擎，并通过主机侧learner、发布门控和步时上界实现训练与推理的高效并发。
en_tdlr: CTRL introduces GPU co-residency as a third RL execution layout where every GPU concurrently hosts a learner and a persistent rollout engine, enabling efficient training-rollout overlap for LLM reinforcement learning.
